newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread up after analysts meeting.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread up after analysts meeting.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc climbed to a peak on Wednesday as analysts made positive comments about the UK brewer after having visited Whitbread's most recent acqusitions yesterday, dealers said.
By 0959 GMT, the shares were up 9p to 809-1/2, having risen as high as 817 earlier.
"There was little news that emerged from the visit, but one gained confidence in the stratey and management team," Goldman Sachs analyst Colin Davies said of the visit.
Davies this morning reiterated his "outperform" rating on the stock.
